items.briefing:
A new survey confirms what many Australians already suspect — 84% believe AI will make cybercrime worse. This concern is well-founded, with recent reports showing cybercriminals hiding malware inside torrents of popular films. Downloading pirated movies remains a real risk, as these files can silently install harmful software on your device.

On a separate note, scammers continue targeting Australians through various channels tracked by Scamwatch. Stay alert to unsolicited contact asking for personal or financial information.

**Practical tip:** Only download movies and TV shows from legitimate, paid services — free torrent sites are increasingly used to spread malware.
